cohort: The study included patients who underwent cesarean section under general anesthesia (n=291) and patients who underwent open gynecologic surgery (n=225).
finding: This study found that postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV) occurs less frequently in patients undergoing cesarean section under general anesthesia than in those undergoing gynecologic surgery, and identified several risk factors for PONV in obstetric patients.
mod_finding: The incidence of postoperative nausea and vomiting was significantly lower in patients undergoing cesarean section under general anesthesia compared to those undergoing gynecologic surgery.
